title: First approved release: paired confirmation outcomes
scope: Historical policy-7 browser confirmation snapshot; excludes pilot, deterministic setup checks, offline datasets and later runs.

provenance.selection: Exact manifest.plan.trials IDs; read trials/{id}.json grade.passed and baseline.grade.passed; join caseId to manifest.cases for original family/category/split.
provenance.verification: All 316 archive entry lengths and SHA-256 values verified; paired counts and gain/loss IDs match archived summary. Saved grades were read, not rerun.

design.unit: case with one original attempt per arm
design.currentPolicyWarning: A later policy requires no lost baseline pass. This historical comparison contains one loss.
design.generalizationLimit: Repeated and authored fixtures; neither production accuracy nor statistical certification. Historical held-out cases are now exposed.
design.latencyLimit: Provider warmth uncontrolled; one observation per case per arm. No statistical speed claim.

latencyMs.definition: Resolver HTTP end-to-end, including capture/model/verification; independent fixture setup and grading excluded; durable budget reservation before execution, reconciliation after provider response and before next trial
